0x00077C.en: 「At my current skill level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000875.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't beat me!」

0x00099E.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x0009D6.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000A9F.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000ADA.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't funny...」

0x000B2E.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail out...」

0x000C7F.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D2B.en: 「No good, I took too many hits...... Retreating!」

0x000D78.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DB6.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000DFD.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000EA8.en: 「Ugh...... To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000F27.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this......!」

0x000F5F.en: 「Ow ow ow...... I give up, miscalculation on my part.」

0x000FA0.en: 「Aw, shoot, they done got me good!」

0x001051.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001098.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0010CD.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00118A.en: 「Ugh...... You're as good as they say.」

0x0011B9.en: 「Getting beaten in a place like this...@　how green of me...!」

0x001207.en: 「No, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0012C2.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x0012F1.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00132F.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00135E.en: 「I can't manage any more than this. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x0013E9.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x00154F.en: 「Ejecting now...@ Ngh...! No dignity in this...」

0x00174D.en: 「This is as far as we go!!」
